rules.title: Function components and hooks
rules.text: Use function components and hooks; do not write class components.

rules.title: Rules of hooks
rules.text: Follow the Rules of Hooks and keep effect dependency arrays exhaustive.

rules.title: Derive state
rules.text: Derive values during render instead of duplicating them in state or syncing them with effects.

rules.title: Stable keys
rules.text: Use stable unique keys for lists, never array indexes for dynamic lists.

rules.title: Colocate state
rules.text: Keep state as close as possible to where it is used.

rules.title: Test with Testing Library
rules.text: Test components through user-visible behavior with React Testing Library, not implementation details.

rules.title: Memoize only with evidence
rules.text: Do not add useMemo, useCallback or memo by default; rely on React Compiler where enabled and memoize by hand only for measured cost or stable effect dependencies.

rules.title: Composition over props
rules.text: Prefer composition (children, slots) over long prop lists and boolean flags.

rules.title: Suspense and error boundaries
rules.text: Use Suspense and error boundaries for async UI states.

rules.title: Consistent form control
rules.text: Keep each input either controlled or uncontrolled, never switching between them.

rules.title: Effects only for sync
rules.text: Use effects only to synchronize with external systems, not for data transformation.

rules.title: One exported component per file
rules.text: Export one main component per file and colocate its tests and styles.
